en-US.description: TailTots for Parents is the voice companion for your real TailTots family. After you link your TailTots parent account in the Alexa app, just ask: what's on today's missions, what needs my approval, how the Kid Bank looks, or how the streaks are going. TailTots turns everyday care, chores, and kindness into real-world missions kids complete — you approve in about 30 seconds, and their streaks prove the habits are sticking. TailTots is parent-led by design: no open chat, no ads, and your family's data stays yours. Linking is free; a TailTots parent account is required.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Tail Tots Parent what needs my approval
Alexa, ask Tail Tots Parent what are today's missions
en-US.name: TailTots for Parents
en-US.summary: Link your TailTots parent account and hear your family's live updates: today's missions, pending approvals, Kid Bank balances, and streaks.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: 1. Enable the skill. 2. In the Alexa app choose Link account and sign in with your TailTots parent account (email magic-link sign-in). 3. Say 'Alexa, open Tail Tots Parent', then 'what needs my approval' or 'today's missions'. If the account is not linked, the skill asks you to link it and reads no family data.
